pi_input_events.summary: Train the RL agents and compare them with fixed dispatch policies.

model_provenance: Local Codex turn-context records identify the parent model and reasoning effort. The listed delegates inherited this configuration without overrides.
pi_input: ny asked to train reinforcement learning agents and compare them with fixed dispatch policies.
pi_feedback: “Try increasing the network size and also experiment on the other 3 instances.”
agent_work: Compared the fixed dispatch policies with the learned agents on instance A. Each RL action selected a rank in the current list of eligible appointments.
computation: Instance A contained 60 appointments. GPU training used four Optuna trials and 16,384 final steps per algorithm. The comparison averaged 12 held-out seeds.
finding: DQN led RL validation. On the held-out seeds it averaged 54.50 visits and 438.08 reward. Random averaged 56.92 visits and 484.41 reward. Earliest deadline and ant colony completed all 60 visits on every seed.

delegation.work: Added earliest-deadline dispatch, optional paired service-time disturbances per appointment, and streamlined dispatch validation.

availability: The results above were recorded in the conversation. Per-seed traces, training losses, and checkpoints from this run are unavailable in the current workspace.
